claims.text: Recent computer-aided approaches face challenges in structural relationship modeling and fine-grained cross-modal alignment.
claims.poster_quote: Recent computer-aided approaches face challenges in structural relationship modeling and fine-grained cross-modal alignment.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions.
claims.reason: The paper outlines these two key challenges faced by recent computer-aided approaches.
